subject.title: fix(release): keep msteams packaging and Docker reruns reliable

question: Should this release-facing packaging change be accepted once the maintainer confirms that the staged Microsoft Teams npm package installs its declared runtime dependencies in the supported publication flow?
rationale: The branch changes a plugin release default with publication and upgrade consequences, and the PR carries the repository's protected `maintainer` label.

options.title: Confirm package acceptance and merge
options.body: Accept the lean archive after confirming the staged package installs and loads its declared Teams/Azure dependencies through npm.

options.title: Retain bundled dependencies
options.body: Keep the existing archive behavior if release acceptance identifies an environment that cannot rely on registry-installed runtime dependencies.

recommendation.title: Confirm package acceptance and merge
recommendation.body: Accept the lean archive after confirming the staged package installs and loads its declared Teams/Azure dependencies through npm.

likelyOwner.reason: They authored and are assigned to the release-recovery repair, with Vincent Koc as an adjacent owner of the related update/doctor release work.
